effect_description_eng: [Start of Your Main Phase] If you have 4 or less memory, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Angel] or [TS] trait in the hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
